Your Shortcut to Instant Effortless Waves Is Here!

Get a longer, thicker blowout in minutes with 16" Xtra Inches Clip-In Extensions. Designed for anyone looking for instant length and volume, these pre-styled hair extensions make you look like you just left the salon. Built with our signature INFINI-FLEX™ fiber, they're 100% premium synthetic hair engineered to hold the style and feel like smooth, healthy hair with a glossy sheen.
 
With loose curls that blend seamlessly with your natural hair, achieving your dream hair has never been this easy. Whether you're glamming up for an event or dressing up your everyday look, Xtra Inches has you covered — no damage, no commitment, no salon appointments.

Each pack comes with five wefts: one 10”, one 8”, one 6”, and two 3” pieces

      Length: 16 inches
      Weight: 180 grams
      Style: Pre-styled loose curls
      INFINI-FLEX™ Vegan Synthetic Hair

          1. Start with dry, tangle-free hair. Section the crown into a top knot.
          Pro Tip: Curl or wave hair to blend with your pre-styled clip-in extensions.

          2. 1st Section (mid ear-to-ear): Clip in the 6" weft.
          For each section: leave about 1/2" of your hair between each layer to conceal the weft.

          3. 2nd Section (above ear-to-ear): Clip in the 8" weft.

          4. Final Section (temple-to-temple): Clip in the 10" weft. Clip the 3" wefts on each side, framing your face.

          5. Release your top knot, lightly brush to blend & enjoy!
